book.name: 1 CORINTHIANS
book.title: Paul CORINTH ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi mohti Pēniata

content: The Question about Food Offered to Idols
Nu pu’ nȫsiwhqat nāp yukit aw noiwhqat yuaatani. Pay pas antsa itam sohsoyam navotit pasiwyuṅwa. Navoti hakiy kwivi’naṅwtoynaṅwu; noqw nami’naṅwa hapi hakiy öqalaṅwu.
Noqw kurs pay hak hihta navoti’taqey wūwante’, pam piw it aw wūwantani: Pam as pas pasiwtaqat put navoti’tani; nīk̇aṅw pam qa nāt pan put navoti’ta.
Hak haqam God aw unaṅway’taqw God put tuwi’taṅwu.
Taay, hak hihta nāp yukit aw noiwhqat tūmoytaqat nu lavayhtini. Pay pi itam navoti’yuṅqw pay tūwaqatsit ep nāp yukit pi qa hímuu; pu pay pas qa haqam hak himu piw suhk̇aa, pay pas God‐saa.
Pay pi as sinmuyniqw amuhpa’ nāwakintiwyaqam k̇asta, ōveqatsit ep’e, pu tūwaqatsit ep’e. Pi pas antsa amuhpa’ nāwakintiwyaqam suhpanta, pu momṅwit suhpanta.

Noqw itamuyniqw pay sūkw aw nāwakintiwhqa, God Itanaa, put hapi ahpiy sohsoy himu pasiwyuṅwa, pu itam put eṅem yukiwyuṅwa; pu sūk̇a Moṅwi, Jesus Christ, put hapi ahpiy sohsoy himu yukiltoti, pu itam put ahpiyya.

Nīk̇aṅw pay qa sohsoyam it navoti’yuṅwa. Oviypi haqawat nāp yukit pew pahsavo k̇aptsi’yuṅwa. Noqw nāmahin pi as púmuyniqw nȫsiwhqa pas antsa nāp yukit aw noiwhq puma put nōnova; noqw puma tuptsiwniy aṅ qaöqáwi’yuṅqw, uṅwáam hovarsni.
Pi itam soon nȫsiwhqat ahpiy God aw lomahinyuṅqey nāmahtakni’yuṅwni. Oviypi itam nȫnöse’ put ahpiy qa ṅas’ewhtotiṅwu; pu pay piw an itam qa nȫnöse’ qa hin’ewaytotiṅwu.
Nīk̇aṅw pay uma tunatyaltotini, taq nāphisat k̇a uma yan qenive hoṅk̇ahk̇aṅw soñawnen tuptsiwniy aṅ qaö’qaltuy amutpik hihta ep tö́nökyaniqat taviyani.
Kurs um hihta navoti’taqa nāp yukit eṅem kīyat ep tunösvoñat aw qatuqw, hak tuptsiwniy qa aṅ öqala uṅ pep tuwani. Ya pam unaṅwpeq qatusite’, qa tuwat nȫsiwhqat nāp yukit aw noiwhqat nösni?
Nen pam hak uhtupko qaöqálanihqe uhnavotiy atsviy hovalniwni, Christ put eṅem enaṅ mokq’ö.
Noqw pan hapi uma umuhtupkomuy ep qaanhtote’ unaṅwayamuy qaö’qaltuy tūhotote’, Christ ep qaanhtotini.
Yanta hapi, noqw ōviy kurs sikwi itupkoy múnuknaniqw, pay pas tūwaqatsit nāt wunuqw nu soon sikwit nösni, taq nāphisat k̇a nu itupkoy múnuknaniqee.
